test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The NVS-02 satellite, launched in 2025, is intended to augment which Indian system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NavIC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The NVS-02 satellite, launched in 2025, is designed to enhance the Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS), also known as **NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation)**.
 
• NavIC is India’s indigenous satellite navigation system, developed by the Indian Space Research Organisation (**ISRO**), to provide accurate positioning services in India and the surrounding region.
 
• The NVS-02 satellite incorporates advanced features, including **dual-frequency signals (L1 and L5 bands)**, to improve navigation accuracy and reliability.
 
• The satellite is part of the effort to **replace and upgrade the aging NavIC constellation**, ensuring the system remains operational and efficient for the long term.
 
• NavIC is intended to provide positioning accuracy of **better than 20 meters** in the primary service area, covering India and an area extending 1,500 km around it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **NavIC Overview:**

 
 
• NavIC consists of a constellation of **seven satellites** and ground systems for monitoring, control, and data processing.
 
• It provides two types of services: the **Standard Positioning Service (SPS)** for civilian use and the **Restricted Service (RS)** for authorized users, including the military.
 
 
 
• **Significance of NavIC:**
 
 
• It is a critical step towards self-reliance in satellite navigation, reducing dependency on global systems like GPS.
 
• NavIC supports applications in **terrestrial, aerial, and marine navigation**, disaster management, vehicle tracking, and more.
 
 
 
• **NVS Series Satellites:**
 
 
• The NVS series is the next generation of satellites designed to replace older NavIC satellites and enhance system capabilities.
 
• These satellites support **dual-frequency signals** for better performance under challenging conditions.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with GPS:**
 
 
• While GPS is a global navigation system, NavIC is designed for regional coverage, offering high accuracy over India and neighboring regions.
 
• NavIC’s restricted service provides **greater resilience and security** for strategic applications.
 
 
 
• **ISRO’s Role:**
 
 
• ISRO is responsible for the development, launch, and maintenance of NavIC and its associated infrastructure.
 
• As of 2025, ISRO continues to enhance NavIC with advanced technologies to keep pace with global navigation systems.
